title: House of European History
scope: The standing Eastman Building at the edge of Leopold Park, Brussels, including Michel Polak’s limestone former clinic and the contemporary glass House of European History extension.
limitations: The standing museum exterior retains the limestone shell and glass addition. The heights, opaque interior volumes’ exact positions behind the roof glass, rear window spacing and roof service forms are representative estimates.
The museum interior, courtyard exhibits, neighboring park and architectural signs at small scale are outside this model.
